Their debut album reached No. 1 and sold over 245,000 copies in its first week, contributing to total sales of over 2 million albums in the UK. In 2024, G4 celebrated their 20th anniversary with a new studio album, G4:20, and a major tour featuring 110 headline shows. They also launched a musical-theatre-style show called Phantoms of the Popera, which has seen sell-out performances and continues with additional shows planned. G4's official store offers their latest album in various formats, showcasing a mix of modern pop and classical pieces.

Operating from its headquarters in Rio de Janeiro, Recode impacts over 1.8 million people across Brazil and 11 other countries. The organization aims to empower individuals to improve their lives through technology, with a vision to create opportunities for 1 million individuals by 2030.

Recode offers a range of free, technology-focused educational programs designed to enhance employability and civic engagement. Key initiatives include Recode Pro, which provides full-stack programming training, and Recode Pro AI, focusing on artificial intelligence. The organization also manages a network of Digital Empowerment Centers, providing resources in various community settings. Recode collaborates with partners like Microsoft and Facebook to deliver its programs and connect individuals with social projects, fostering a more just society through technology.

Through its comprehensive approach, FGV plays a vital role in Brazil's socioeconomic development.

With a strong commitment to workforce development, it serves students, industrial companies, and vulnerable populations, acting as a vital link between education and industry in Brazil.

FTD Educação is a Brazilian company specializing in educational publishing and solutions, founded in 1902 by the Marist Brothers. Based in São Paulo, it has over 120 years of experience in the national market. FTD is one of the largest leaders in educational solutions in Brazil, serving more than 20 million students across all levels of Basic Education. The company publishes over 60 million books annually and operates one of the largest printing parks in Latin America.

FTD Educação offers an integrated ecosystem of educational solutions, including textbooks for all stages of Basic Education, the FTD Teaching System, and various educational support services. They provide tools that enhance teaching both inside and outside the classroom, including digital platforms and resources focused on robotics and programming. The company also develops specific solutions for public education, aiming to improve educational outcomes in municipalities. FTD is committed to transforming society through education, emphasizing the importance of discovery, choice, and citizenship.

Senai São Paulo (SENAI-SP) is a private, non-profit institution dedicated to enhancing the competitiveness of the industrial sector in São Paulo through professional education, innovation, technology, and industrial entrepreneurship. Founded on January 22, 1942, it has over 80 years of experience and is the largest provider of skilled labor training in Brazil, with more than 1 million enrollments annually.

SENAI-SP operates 90 professional training units and 78 mobile schools across the state, offering a comprehensive range of educational programs. These include initial training, professional qualification, technical courses, and higher education in various fields such as Food and Beverage, Automotive, Electronics, Graphic Arts, Mechanics, Metallurgy, and Textiles. The institution also engages in research and development projects to boost productivity and competitiveness for businesses, alongside supporting startups and fostering an innovative culture. 

SENAI-SP serves companies of all sizes and sectors, as well as students and professionals looking to enter or advance in the industrial market, making it a key player in Brazil's industrial training and innovation landscape.

FIESC (Federação das Indústrias do Estado de Santa Catarina) is the main representative organization for the industrial sector in Santa Catarina, Brazil. Founded in 1950 and based in Florianópolis, FIESC is a nonprofit entity that supports the development and competitiveness of the state's industry. It employs around 1,797 people and reported an annual revenue of $100 million in 2025.

FIESC operates through a system of five entities, each with specific missions. These include SESI/SC, which provides social services and health support for workers; SENAI/SC, focused on industrial education and training; IEL/SC, dedicated to innovation and entrepreneurship; and CIESC, which represents and develops the industry. FIESC offers a range of services, including education, health and social services, research and innovation support, and programs aimed at enhancing the competitiveness of the industrial sector. Its mission is to advocate for industrial interests and create a favorable business environment in Santa Catarina.

FUNDASP focuses on fostering citizenship and Brazilian identity while preserving historical, cultural, and artistic heritage.

Additionally, FUNDASP engages in social assistance initiatives aimed at promoting social inclusion and integration into the labor market, along with cultural preservation efforts that defend and promote artistic expression. Its beneficiaries include students, researchers, and communities served by its educational and social programs.

Universidade do Estado de Santa Catarina (UDESC) is a public state university in Brazil, established in 1965. It offers free higher education, research, and extension activities throughout Santa Catarina. UDESC is the only higher education institution maintained by the State Government of Santa Catarina and operates under the legal-institutional model of Fundação Universidade do Estado de Santa Catarina.

With approximately 14,000 to 15,000 students, UDESC provides a wide range of academic programs, including over 60 undergraduate courses and more than 50 postgraduate programs. The university has a multicampus structure with 13 units across 10 cities, including major campuses in Florianópolis and Joinville. UDESC also supports distance education through partnerships with the Open University of Brazil, featuring over 30 in-person support centers. The university is dedicated to fostering knowledge in various fields, including health, technology, education, and the arts, while actively engaging in research and cultural development for the benefit of society.

It is recognized for its commitment to equality, plurality, and citizenship, making it a leader in social citizenship initiatives. The university serves around 40,000 students through a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, supported by a faculty of approximately 3,000 professors.

UERJ is also a hub for research and community engagement, hosting 346 research groups and nearly 500 extension projects that connect the university with local communities. It offers health services through the Hospital Universitário Pedro Ernesto and the Policlínica Piquet Carneiro. UERJ actively promotes cultural activities and provides opportunities for students to engage with industry and government partners through various student organizations. The university is recognized as one of the top higher education institutions in Brazil, contributing significantly to the academic landscape.

Firjan, or the Federação das Indústrias do Estado do Rio de Janeiro, is a private, non-profit organization that represents the industrial sector in Rio de Janeiro. Founded on April 16, 1975, it has roots dating back to 1827. Firjan serves as the official voice of over 10,000 industrial companies and 101 industrial unions at municipal, state, and federal levels.

The organization focuses on creating a favorable business environment and enhancing competitiveness, education, and quality of life for industrial workers and society. Firjan offers essential services such as business consulting, research and debates on sustainable development, and recognition of best manufacturing practices. It also provides specialized support for the oil and gas sector, along with innovation and research initiatives through its advanced laboratories. As part of the FIRJAN system, which includes several affiliated institutions, Firjan plays a crucial role in fostering industrial growth in the region.

SENAI (Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Industrial) is the largest institution for professional and technological education in Latin America. Established on January 22, 1942, it is a private, non-profit entity aimed at developing qualified labor for the Brazilian industry. SENAI operates as a social service outside public administration and is part of the "Third Sector," integrating with the Sistema Indústria alongside CNI, SESI, and IEL.

It offers a wide range of educational programs, from basic education to postgraduate studies, in both in-person and distance learning formats. SENAI also provides technological services, including consulting, applied research, and laboratory testing, to enhance industrial competitiveness. Its mission is to promote the competitiveness of the Brazilian industry through education, innovation, and technology transfer.

Fundada em 1992, a URI foi a primeira universidade multicampi do país, com a missão de integrar comunidades gaúchas e promover o desenvolvimento socioeconômico, educacional, cultural e político.

A URI oferece uma ampla variedade de cursos de graduação e pós-graduação, tanto presenciais quanto a distância. Os cursos incluem bacharelados, licenciaturas e cursos superiores tecnológicos, abrangendo diversas áreas do conhecimento. A URI é reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação e se dedica a formar estudantes para o desenvolvimento social e humano.

Senac's commitment to quality education and workforce development makes it a key player in Brazil's vocational training landscape.

Sistema Fiep is a non-profit industrial development organization based in Curitiba, Paraná, Brazil. Established in 1943, it comprises four integrated institutions: Fiep, Sesi, Senai, and IEL. The organization aims to promote and defend the interests of Paraná's industrial sector, enhancing competitiveness and sustainable development.

Each institution within Sistema Fiep focuses on specific areas. Fiep advocates for industrial interests and provides economic research and support for business syndicates. Sesi focuses on worker well-being through health, safety, and education programs. Senai offers technical education and training to meet industrial demands, while IEL promotes innovation and leadership by connecting companies with universities and research centers. Additionally, Sistema Fiep operates the Campus da Indústria, which includes the Parque Tecnológico da Indústria to foster innovation in Brazil. 

The organization serves industrial companies, workers, business leaders, and academic institutions in Paraná, reinvesting resources to support its mission.

Serviço Social do Comércio - SESC PR, or Sesc Paraná, is a private, non-profit organization focused on enhancing the social well-being and quality of life for workers in the commerce sector, their families, and the wider community. Established in 1949 in Paraná, Brazil, Sesc Paraná operates under the national framework of Serviço Social do Comércio (SESC) and is funded through a compulsory payroll contribution from commercial employers.

The organization provides a wide range of socio-educational and assistential services across six strategic areas: social action, culture, education, sports and leisure, health, and tourism. With 36 physical service points and 6 mobile units, Sesc Paraná ensures accessibility to its services, particularly in municipalities with lower development indices. Its mission is to promote social equity and inclusion, offering programs that support vulnerable populations, enhance employability, and foster community engagement.

União Brasileira de Educação Católica (UBEC) é uma associação civil sem fins econômicos, fundada em 1972 em Brasília. A organização se dedica à gestão de uma rede educacional que abrange desde a Educação Básica até o Ensino Superior, promovendo uma educação integral baseada em valores humanos e cristãos. Com nove unidades de missão em quatro estados brasileiros e no exterior, a UBEC atende mais de 22 mil estudantes por meio de cursos presenciais e a distância.

A UBEC administra instituições de ensino, incluindo a Universidade Católica de Brasília e outras faculdades em Minas Gerais, Tocantins e Pernambuco. Oferece uma ampla gama de cursos, desde educação infantil até doutorados, além de programas de educação técnica. A organização é composta por várias províncias religiosas e uma diocese, e reinveste seus recursos no fortalecimento de sua rede educacional, impactando positivamente a vida de estudantes, famílias e a comunidade cristã.

The company offers a range of online courses and mentorship programs in areas such as UX/UI Design, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Product Management. The company was acquired by Fluency Academy in April 2024 and has around 40 employees.

The organization employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people and is headquartered in São Paulo, SP.

CIEE provides 100% free services aimed at helping young individuals understand their rights and achieve job market inclusion. Their offerings include internship and apprenticeship placements, social assistance, citizenship education, and recruitment services for companies. Additionally, CIEE partners with international institutions to offer college study abroad programs in Brazil, which feature various academic and internship opportunities. The organization demonstrates a strong social return on investment, providing R$20.65 in services for every R$1.00 invested.

It operates as a private, non-profit entity dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for industrial workers, their families, and the wider community. SESI is the largest private network of basic education in Brazil, serving over 300,000 students across approximately 450 schools. The organization is headquartered in Brasília and is funded by contributions from the Brazilian industrial sector.

SESI offers a wide range of services focused on four main areas: Education, Health, Leisure, and Social Responsibility. Its educational programs include basic education and technical training tailored for the industrial workforce. Health services aim to improve worker safety and productivity through occupational health programs and safety training. SESI also promotes cultural and recreational activities to foster community engagement and personal development. Additionally, it provides consulting services to help industrial companies implement socially responsible practices, enhancing both worker well-being and industrial competitiveness.

Cebraspe is recognized as one of the leading examination boards in Brazil, particularly for federal public tenders and large-scale selection processes.

Its primary clients include federal government agencies, public institutions, and military forces, contributing to merit-based recruitment and public administration in Brazil.
